verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since PagerDuty is an on-call scheduling product and documents schedules (pagerduty-docs-12), but nothing in the pack describes an iCal/webcal feed or any export of a user's shifts to a personal calendar. The Shift Agent (pagerduty-docs-58) reads calendars to detect conflicts rather than publishing shifts to them. The community remark about 'clunky calendar overrides' concerns schedule overrides, not feed subscription.
